title: Leaf-Similar Trees
summary: Two binary trees are deemed leaf-similar if their sequences of leaf values, read from left to right, are identical.
statement: Two binary trees are deemed leaf-similar if their sequences of leaf values, read from left to right, are identical. Given two tree roots, root1 and root2, return true if their leaf sequences match, otherwise return false.
constraints: Read leaves from left to right in each binary tree.
Return whether the two leaf-value sequences are identical.
Internal node values do not affect the result.
